name: Product Table Builder for WooCommerce
author: StorePlugin

sections.description:
Enhance your WooCommerce store with the ultimate product table solution. The Product Table Builder plugin empowers you to create, customize, and manage product tables with ease, offering a wide range of features designed to improve your store’s user experience and functionality.

Documentation

Key Features:

  • Drag-and-Drop Table Builder: Effortlessly create and organize your product tables with our intuitive drag-and-drop interface. No coding skills required.
  • Customizable Table Elements: Tailor your product tables to suit your specific needs. Add, remove, and customize elements such as product name, price, SKU, image, and more.
  • Appearance Customization: Personalize the look and feel of your tables to match your brand. Adjust colors, fonts, borders, and other visual elements.
  • Advanced Query Builder: Use the query builder to filter and display products based on specific criteria, ensuring your customers see exactly what they’re looking for.
  • Sorting and Table Pagination: Enable easy navigation through large product lists with sorting options and pagination controls.
  • “Add to Cart” Functionality: Allow customers to add products to their cart directly from the table, streamlining the shopping experience.

Premium Features:

  • Premium Table Elements: Unlock advanced features like Author, Upsell, Cross-Sell, Custom Text, Space, and many more to enrich your product data.
  • Advanced Query Builder: Get premium options such as price, Featured, Stock Quantity, Product Type, Author, and additional filters for a more powerful query builder.
  • Mobile Responsive Table: Enjoy a seamless mobile-responsive product table for the best experience on all devices.
  • Premium Design and Typography Customization: Fully personalize your table’s design and typography for a unique, branded look.
  • Import/Export: Efficiently manage woo product data and styles with enhanced import/export features.
  • Premium Support: Gain access to priority support for a faster, more tailored experience.

With Product Table Builder, managing and displaying your WooCommerce products has never been easier. Enhance your store’s functionality and provide your customers with an optimized shopping experience today.
sections.installation:
1. Upload product-table-builder-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Clcik Product Tables menu and create your first table
sections.faq:
Is Product Table Builder compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, Product Table Builder is fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS.

Can I customize the appearance of my product tables?

Yes, you can customize the appearance of your product tables to match your brand. Adjust colors, fonts, borders, and other visual elements to create a unique look. Advanced customization options are available in the premium version.

Can I import/export product tables between websites?

Yes, you can easily import and export product tables between websites using the import/export feature. This allows you to transfer tables or save them for future use. This is a premium feature.

Is Product Table Builder mobile responsive?

Yes, Product Table Builder is built with responsiveness in mind, ensuring that your product tables look great on all devices. This is a premium feature.

Can I add products to the cart directly from the table?

Yes, you can enable “Add to Cart” functionality in your product tables, allowing customers to add products to their cart directly from the table.

Is there a limit to the number of product tables I can create?

No, there is no limit to the number of product tables you can create. You can create as many tables as you need to display your products effectively.

Can I display product variations in my product tables?

Yes, you can display product variations in your product tables using variation element.

Can I display product categories & tags in my product tables?

Yes, you can display product categories & tags in your product tables using category and tags elements.

Can I display product attributes in my product tables?

Yes, you can display product attributes in your product tables.
